list: The official 55 PlayStation 5 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written for this entry, in its own words, and cites its source. Five trophies are marked confirmed: false — no published guide had confirmed their exact trigger when this entry was written, and their guides say so instead of guessing.
notes: Every trophy is earned offline in story mode. There are no online trophies, no mission gold medals and no mission replay.
One playthrough is enough: free roam stays open after the story ends, so almost nothing can be missed.
The one exception is Positive Mental Attitude (meditate at every spot): one meditation spot sits at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so meditate there at the first chance.
Cheats switch trophies and saving off for that session, so keep cheats for a throwaway save, or for after the list is done.
Hunters put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours, most of it inside the 100% Completion trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and it needs no plan of its own. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, the one missable meditation in Chapter 1, then stranger strands, activities, crime and collectibles — and it pops the moment the 54th trophy lands.
steps: Work the roadmap phases in order.
Tick each trophy off here as it pops, so nothing is left behind.
The platinum unlocks automatically with the 54th trophy.
trophies.source: Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, played as Jason, and the trophy is automatic: play the mission through to its end and it pops on completion. Nothing before it can be missed, so just enjoy the introduction to Leonida.
steps: Start the story and play Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play every Chapter 1 mission to the end of the chapter. Chapter trophies are automatic, and free roam stays open afterwards, so there is nothing to miss — but do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter ends.
steps: Finish all Chapter 1 missions.
Meditate at Jason's house first — the one missable spot.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its final mission. Like every chapter trophy it unlocks on its own at the chapter's end, with no side requirement attached.
steps: Finish all Chapter 2 missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. This is the chapter where the story reaches Vice City itself, and the trophy pops automatically when the last mission of the chapter is done.
steps: Finish all Chapter 3 missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. Keep the story moving and leave side content for free roam — it all stays available after the credits.
steps: Finish all Chapter 4 missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. There is no mission replay and no gold-medal requirement anywhere in the game, so simply completing it is enough — and free roam continues after the credits for everything that is left.
steps: Play the final mission to the end.
Free roam opens again after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission: it arrives in the normal course of the plot, and the trophy pops when it is done. Story missions cannot be missed, so just keep playing.
steps: Play Breakfast Run when the story brings it to you.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission, so it comes to you as the plot reaches it. Finish the mission and the trophy follows — heists are story beats, not side jobs.
steps: Play The Cartel Heist when the story reaches it.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. It shows up as the story unfolds — play it through and the trophy is yours.
steps: Play Child's Play when the story brings it to you.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission, so it arrives in the normal course of the plot. Finish it and the trophy pops.
steps: Play Headliners when the story brings it to you.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set at Vice City International Airport. It comes to you through the plot — finish it and the trophy pops.
steps: Play VCIA Takedown when the story brings it to you.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission. Like every story trophy it cannot be missed — play it when the plot reaches it.
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory when the story brings it to you.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest grind on the list — hunters put the whole Platinum at about 200 hours, most of it here. 100% means the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the challenges and the collectibles, all of them tracked by the game's own completion checklist. Work this guide's roadmap to the end and tick everything off here; the side content beyond the checklist is optional.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Clear the activities, challenges and collectibles.
Use this guide's checklist to track what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps and unique stunts both count. Learn the ramps on the map, and once you find a short jump you can land cleanly, repeat it rather than hunting for new ones each time.
steps: Find a ramp with a clean, repeatable landing.
Land the jump, then repeat it until the count is done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type on the map — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, drone races, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win any of them, so treat it as a taster tour of everything Leonida offers.
steps: Open the map and visit each activity marker once.
Play a round of each — winning is not required.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 in total. Each challenge is scored on its own, so take one weapon at a time and retry a single challenge until it is gold; you never need a perfect run across the whole range at once.
steps: Work through the range one weapon at a time.
Retry a single challenge until it is gold, then move on.
trophies.source: GamesFuze — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each Top Fun venue — 14 locations in all. Fly a slow lap first to learn the course line, then race it for real. The win counts once per location, so move on as soon as each one is won.
steps: Fly a slow practice lap to learn the course.
Race it and win, then move to the next venue.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Road, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each one is a different event — repeating the same race does not add to the count, so keep entering new ones.
steps: Enter races you have not won yet.
Win 20 different events across any race types.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Keep the line tension steady and reel only when there is slack — fighting the fish too hard snaps the line, and a snapped line costs you the challenge.
steps: Take Cal's fishing challenge.
Reel on the slack, ease off on the runs.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game. Pick the shortest one in the arcade and play it through once — completion is what counts, not a high score.
steps: Walk into any arcade.
Play the shortest game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission, Puff Puff Pass. Stranger strands unlock as you explore, so check in with Andy whenever his marker appears on the map.
steps: Follow Andy's strand whenever his marker appears.
Finish its final mission, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission. Strands stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed — work it whenever Kenton's marker is up.
steps: Follow Kenton's strand whenever his marker appears.
Finish its final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission. Work the strand whenever Billy's marker is on the map.
steps: Follow Billy's strand whenever his marker appears.
Finish its final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Do them as you find them — they also count toward 100% Completion, so the time is never wasted, and they unlock as you explore rather than all at once.
steps: Take every stranger marker you pass.
Finish eight full strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through to its final mission. Strands stay open in free roam, so just keep checking his marker.
steps: Follow Randy's strand whenever his marker appears.
Finish its final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission, Spin On This. Like every strand it stays available in free roam.
steps: Follow Tyrone's strand whenever his marker appears.
Finish its final mission, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy the guides flag as possibly missable. One meditation spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so meditate there the first chance you get, before the story moves on. There are 18 spots in total: work through them as you travel, and tick each one off here so none is left behind.
steps: Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — first chance.
Meditate at the other 17 spots as you travel.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunt and track the unique animal he names. Use a scoped rifle, approach downwind, and take the shot from cover — spooking it sends it running and the hunt starts over.
steps: Take Bret's hunt.
Track the animal downwind and shoot from cover.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find and complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so track them by set rather than one card at a time, and finish the three smallest sets first.
steps: Collect cards and sort them by set.
Complete three full sets, smallest first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. It counts per location, so keep moving and tag new spots rather than repeating one — a road trip around the state knocks out dozens in a single run.
steps: Open WAiNK at every new location you reach.
A road trip around the state clears dozens at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Pick the easy ones first — driving, combat and exploration challenges stack up naturally as you play, so check the list early and chase the ones you are already close to.
steps: Open the challenge list and note the ones nearly done.
Finish 50, easiest first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide — in an alley, a parking garage or off-road — until the wanted level clears. Do it away from police helicopters, which keep spotting you from the air.
steps: Bring your partner and raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until it clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Chain three shop robberies with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. Plan a route between three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving — if the wanted level drops, the chain breaks and you start again.
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob them in a row without losing the wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive or ride anything new you see — the count is per vehicle model, so variety matters more than mileage. Car meets, docks and airfields are the fastest places to find new models.
steps: Drive or ride every new model you see.
Check car meets, docks and airfields for rare models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight — a gang shootout, not a duel — and line the shots up before you trigger it.
steps: Find a crowded fight with five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop all five.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — get onto the airfield, take a plane or a fast vehicle, and leave in a hurry before security closes in.
steps: Get onto the VCIA airfield.
Take a plane or a fast vehicle and leave fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino. The military base is where to look: expect a heavy wanted response the moment you climb in, so plan the escape route before you take it, and drive straight for open road.
steps: Reach the military base and find a Rhino.
Climb in and drive for open road at once.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being spotted. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the guards, take the goods and leave before any alarm — one detection voids the attempt, so restart the job if you are seen.
steps: Case the store: cameras and guard routes first.
Go in quiet, take the goods, leave before any alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get away each time. Timing a job around an armored-truck delivery helps get the vault open — and a clean getaway vehicle parked nearby helps just as much.
steps: Park a getaway vehicle nearby before the job.
Rob the vault and escape — five times.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck, take the cash and escape before the police close in. Ram it to a stop or block it, grab the money fast, and have a getaway car ready before you start.
steps: Have a getaway car ready.
Stop the truck, grab the cash, escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside. The count ticks up as new areas are discovered, so a slow drive around the state's edges fills it in.
steps: Drive the edges of the map: coast, Keys, swamps, countryside.
New areas tick the count up as you find them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each gang in Leonida — one per gang, not one per site. Work down the gang list and tick each off as you hit its operation.
steps: Find each gang's illegal operation.
Rob one per gang, ticking the gang list off.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED: reports say this is earned by enjoying a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach. Treat it as a lead, not a guarantee, until players confirm the exact trigger — do not chase it on a rumour.
steps: Watch for player confirmations of the exact trigger.
Until then, treat any rumoured method as unconfirmed.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements (still being confirmed)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED: reports say this is earned by smashing out of a vehicle showroom. The exact trigger is still being confirmed, so treat any rumoured method as unconfirmed and check back for player confirmations.
steps: Watch for player confirmations of the exact trigger.
Until then, treat any rumoured method as unconfirmed.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements (still being confirmed)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kingpin Bowling alley: the related step reported by guides is stealing all 3 key valuables there. Go in, take the valuables and get out — and while you are there, bowl a frame for the fun of it.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling alley.
Take all 3 key valuables, then bowl a frame.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters — gym sessions, fights and heavy work all build strength — until each one is maxed.
steps: Train Jason's strength to max.
Train Lucia's strength to max.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 Criminal Profile actions — the small criminal acts the profile tracks, built up over the course of play. It is a slow counter, so it lands naturally if you play the criminal side of the game; check the profile now and then to see how close you are.
steps: Play the criminal side: small criminal acts count.
Check the Criminal Profile to see the running total.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide gives exact steps for this trophy. The description hints at a second attempt at something — watch for player confirmations and do not chase guesses.
steps: Watch for player confirmations.
Do not chase guesses.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements (still being confirmed)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide gives exact steps for this trophy. The name hints at a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida — treat any rumoured trigger as unconfirmed.
steps: Watch for player confirmations.
Treat any rumoured trigger as unconfirmed.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements (still being confirmed)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED: as of 20 November 2026 no published guide gives exact steps for this trophy. The description suggests a bowling-alley drive-by with a melee weapon — unconfirmed, so do not treat any rumoured method as fact.
steps: Watch for player confirmations.
Do not treat any rumoured method as fact.
trophies.source: GTAScoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements (still being confirmed)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Bank jobs and armored trucks are the steadiest source of marked bills — launder each haul as it comes in rather than stockpiling it.
steps: Rob banks and armored trucks for marked bills.
Launder each haul through your contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida — clothes, food, weapons and vehicles all count. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so it usually lands on its own late in the game.
steps: Shop as you play — clothes, food, weapons, vehicles.
The total adds up across the whole playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. Save up and buy each one as its listing appears — garages also give you somewhere to keep the vehicles you are collecting for Whip It Good.
steps: Watch for garage listings as you play.
Buy all 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app — any 10 distinct vehicles you own. Register each new vehicle as you get it and the count climbs on its own.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app for each vehicle you own.
Register 10 distinct vehicles.
